messages:
Maria P.: Heads-up — EmberAI just asked if we can pin OM-v2 (openmodel-v2) in eu-west + eu-central for their pilot. They need version pin + geo residency + a latency SLO for chat (99th <= 150ms).
Jess K. (Sales): Deal signal — they want this in contract. If we can't guarantee region + pin, they won't sign.
Sanjay (Support): Are they ok with a quantized fallback? EmberAI cites cost constraints but needs strict data residency.
Ashok R.: Quick notes: OM-v2 upstream ships fp16 and int8. Our int8 path hasn't been validated on the EU config (A100-pool + custom kernels). We need a small validation matrix (latency p50/p95/p99, mem, perf regression).
Olivia (Infra): Capacity-wise we can carve Dedicated pool in eu-west, but Private (VPC) rollout needs cross-team networking approvals (DMZ + KMS). That typically adds 2 weeks.
Maria P.: Can we scope acceptance criteria so Sales can commit a timeline? Minimal ask from EmberAI: 1) model pinned in catalog for eu regions, 2) documented fallback policy (quantized variant ok only if within quality guardrails), 3) 99th <=150ms for 8k context on expected qps (TBD).
Ashok R.: Proposal: run this validation job on a single dedicated node, 24h perf sweep + eval prompt set (we'll use emberai/test-prompts). If p99 >150ms on fp16, try int8 and measure quality delta.
Ashok R.: Command we can run for initial perf check:
```
# run perf harness
./run_perf --model om-v2 --region eu-west --bs 1 --seq 8192 --iters 500
```
Sanjay (Support): I'll drop EmberAI's eval set into the test harness and run quality diffs. Do we allow an automatic fallback to om-v2-int8? EmberAI wants cost cap but will accept quality checks.
Maria P.: For product backlog: create an intake ticket with priority = deal-critical, attach contract timeline, and include acceptance criteria: pinned catalog entry, region routing policy, rollback plan, and docs for Private network requirements.
Jess K. (Sales): Timeline ask from customer: signature in 3 weeks. Can we commit to a validation sprint in the next 7 calendar days? Need a clear go/no-go for them.
Olivia (Infra): We can unblock the validation (dedicated test node) within 72 hours if eng signs off on test config. Production Private rollout will still need infra approvals ~2w.
Ashok R.: I'll run perf + quality sweep. If int8 quality loss > 2% on our eval metric, we should disallow auto-fallback and require fp16 Dedicated at contract time.
Maria P.: Acceptance criteria (proposed):
- Catalog: om-v2 pinned in eu-west/eu-central with immutable model_version tag
- Routing: emberai tenant routed to Dedicated pool in eu region; fallback rules explicit (no auto-fallback unless quality delta <=2%)
- SLO: measured p99 <=150ms on customer workload sample during validation window
- Security: KMS-backed keys for model artifacts + audit logs retained 90d
- Docs: Private network runbook + infra checklist for customer onboarding
(Please comment / edit)
Jess K. (Sales): I'll update the term sheet to reflect these bullets and set expectation for 3-week signature contingent on go/no-go results.
Sanjay (Support): I'll run the first quality sweep tonight and paste diffs here.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: perf-harness -> test-dedicated/eu-west at 2026-03-22T02:00Z (no-prod impact).
Ashok R.: Noted. I'll post test artifacts + perf numbers in the intake ticket once complete.
Maria P.: Thanks — can product (me) convert this into a backlog intake ticket? Priority: P0 (sales-driven). If anyone sees missing criteria call it out now.
Olivia (Infra): Add infra checklist: VPC peering, KMS policy, private egress, and capacity reservation ID.
Jess K. (Sales): Adding EmberAI contract contact: laura@emberai.com — I'll sync with legal. :+1:
Maria P.: Great. Next steps: (1) Ashok/Sanjay run validation, (2) Olivia reserve test capacity, (3) Product files intake ticket with acceptance criteria and timeline. We'll reconvene on results in this thread.
